TEXT: [FI] Two days after the field trip ended.
[FI] I went to Akihabara on my day off to give Saori some souvenirs.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] She told me over the phone that she also had something to talk about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What could she be wanting to talk to me about?
[FI] The only thing I could think of, naturally, was otaku-related stuff.
[FI] For example, things like, "This model is limited to one per person, so I would like you to come with me!".
[FI] Or maybe, "I bought a life-size figurine, help me carry it!"
[FI] It has to be something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: [FI] Hey-! Kyousuke-shi～!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, my sincerest apologies! The preparations took me longer than I thought they would.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's okay, I just got here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Wait, what's with those bags?
[FI] What's she planning? Is she going to go to war with those huge things?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Here, give me some of those bags, they look heavy.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Don't be concerned, I have it under control!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] With that said, shall we depart to a cafe or some such in lieu of idly standing around?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] By a cafe you mean...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Heh heh heh...
[FI] When she gives this catty smile...
[FI] It definitely means we're going there...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...A maid cafe, of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAID
TEXT: [FI] Welcome back, Master, Mistress.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Phew... There... we... go...
[FI] Saori's backpack looks pretty heavy. I wonder what's inside?
[FI] ...Oh yeah...
[FI] Oh right, the souvenirs...! I should give them to her...
[FI] That's what I thought, but this stuff she's carrying...
[FI] Just looking at it, it seemed like it's at least 2 or 3 kilos...
[FI] We still have places to go.ãééMaybe I should wait until we part ways.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Here, your souvenirs. Although I couldn't get what you wanted...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] How about this! Limited edition regional robot model available only in Kyoto!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ah... Not bad...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] This model does indeed make my heart just leap! It's brimming with an aura of the old capital, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh? You don't like it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] By no means! That's not it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm beyond grateful for your good will, but I am in no position to accept it at the present time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] At the present time? Ah, because you're going shopping afterwards, so it will unduly increase your total cargo?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's all right. I'll hold on to it until you're done shopping.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] No, it's not that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What is it? Just tell me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] If I accept it, it might 【never come true】.
[FI] What    are    you    saying!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What does that even mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you don't like the gift... you should just say so, if it was because I didn't get what you asked.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] No, that's nowhere close to the case!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I have the utmost gratitude for your gift.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But, for now it's not possible for me to accept...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm...
[FI] Looks like it's not because she doesn't like the souvenir...
[FI] But if that's the case, I have no idea what's going on.
[FI] It'll "never come true" if she accepts it... what's up with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] This can't be counted as compensation...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] As a replacement...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What!? Don't suddenly place those bags on the table!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, it's been on my mind from the start, but what's inside?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Nothing much! It is just my trifling gift.
[FI] Saori rummaged through her backpack and took out something...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Th-This is...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It is as you see,  my humble collection!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] All of them rare and premium goods...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...It may not be much, but I gather that Kyousuke-shi would be interested in it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This development is too sudden, and I can't get a grip. Can you explain what's going on from the beginning?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well, it is like this and that, et cetera...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see, so that's why it's like this and that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Tsk, this isn't a manga or game, how would I know!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha!
[FI] Damn... This person's having fun at my expense...
[FI] ...I took a look at another one on the table.
[FI] Each and every one of them are either limited editions or out of print; they are basically collector's items.
[FI] This figure is so hard to obtain that you can only find it in auctions...
[FI] And this game is autographed by the voice actress...?!
[FI] Aside from that, there are two beam sabers sticking out of her backpack...
[FI] It's as if the pair of white blades are extending to the heavens...
[FI] ...No, wait. I have seen this somewhere...
[FI] What? It's not part of the trophy rewards from that competition?
[FI] No, no, that was just for the sabers.
[FI] Even so, I have no idea what Saori's intentions are, letting go of all these collectible goods...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't this the tournament prize from before? We split it among ourselves.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That's right! One of the finest pieces in my collection, filled with memories from that day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Aren't these all the things that you treasure the most?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, certainly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't say it so lightly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If it's that important, then keep it properly, and don't just give it to others.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wh-What is it, getting serious all of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It is precisely because these are 【truly valuable things】, that I would like you to have them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wait, I don't get it at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Now now, at any rate...
